completed_independent_work: The app visibly rendered English copy in the pinned runtime; alternate locales are outside the approved dossier scope.
fallback: Treat the observed English app UI as the runtime language authority without asserting a device locale.
resume_procedure: The device owner opens Settings → General → Language & Region on the physical iPhone.
The owner reports only the Language and Region values, or approves a tightly cropped screenshot containing only those values.
The discovery driver updates the authority and environment cell without retaining Apple ID, location, preferred-language history, or other settings.

affected_records: future Search rows whose behavior differs by entitlement
completed_independent_work: No in-app account, sign-in state, trial banner, paywall, or entitlement badge was visible on the empty Search root. The installed app identity and build are pinned.
fallback: Describe only the observed installed runtime and do not call it paid, Pro, trial, subscribed, or account-bound.
resume_procedure: The device owner states whether this installation is paid/Pro, trial, free, or otherwise entitled without disclosing an Apple ID or receipt.
During Search reconnaissance, record any limit, paywall, restore-purchase control, or entitlement-dependent Search behavior if it becomes reachable.
Update the authority and every affected journey row with the confirmed state and evidence source.
blocks_final_rows: Any later row claiming paid/Pro-only Search behavior

field: camera, Photos, Files, and clipboard permission/access states
affected_records: future image and input journey rows
completed_independent_work: The owner authorized app-specific permission testing and restoration. The baseline avoided the camera view, personal Photo Library, personal Files, and clipboard payloads.
fallback: Keep permission-dependent journeys unknown rather than infer their state from the visible Search controls.
resume_procedure: Prepare a non-personal camera scene, a limited Photos library containing only a synthetic fixture, a synthetic file, and a known synthetic Mac clipboard value.
Enter each approved Search path separately and record whether iOS prompts, allows, denies, or opens a picker.
Cancel before selecting unrelated content, restore each app-specific permission to its recorded starting state, and retain only synthetic evidence.
Update the relevant matrix cell and atomic rows independently for allow, deny, cancel, retry, and restoration.

completed_independent_work: The exact screen geometry and 3× display scale are pinned in the baseline evidence.
fallback: Describe geometry as observed without labelling the content-size category.
resume_procedure: The device owner reports the current Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size position and whether Accessibility Larger Text is enabled.
Record the resulting category only if iOS or an approved inspection tool exposes its canonical name; otherwise retain the observed geometry without inference.
blocks_final_rows: Any later row claiming Dynamic Type behavior

completed_independent_work: iPhone Mirroring and Xcode Accessibility Inspector were both attempted against the pinned runtime; only the mirroring shell tree was returned.
fallback: Use a device-owner-assisted VoiceOver traversal and keep screenshots classified as visual rather than semantic evidence.
resume_procedure: Retry Accessibility Inspector with Nihongo foregrounded and iPhone Mirroring disconnected.
If elements remain unavailable, traverse each approved Search surface with VoiceOver and record labels, traits, focus order, actions, and transitions using synthetic content.
Keep each accessibility row blocked until that environment-bound evidence exists.
